text:
anya: Quick sync — proposing an interop litmus: Snowflake external function -> Databricks transform -> Qdrant vector index. Goal: verify marketplace listing end-to-end and surface any friction points before partner dry run.

jordan: SGTM. Which connector versions are we validating?

anya: Targeting Snowflake connector v1.9.2, DBX runtime 13.1, qdrant 1.2. We'll also try quantized embedding pipeline to catch perf regressions.

luis: Need to flag data residency/KMS for the Private marketplace listing. Who will provision test keys? :eyes:

samir: I can stand up ephemeral test KMS and a VPC peering route. Plan for smoke dataset ~5k rows (doc+meta). Keep PII out.

kate: From GTM — timeline question: if litmus is green, when can we coordinate a joint announcement window? Need ~3w lead for partner comms. :calendar:

anya: Realistic schedule: smoke + perf by next Wed, partner review the following Tue, announcement target ~3 weeks after partner sign-off. If smoke fails, that shifts.

qdrant_ops: dev cluster available at qdrant-qa.svc:6333. Recommend using snapshot policy retention=7d for the run to keep costs low.

jordan: Quick test snippet for the embedding -> upsert path (we'll add to the runbook):

```
# fetch embeddings from DBX job
curl -X POST https://rbx-integ-2.jobs/api/embeddings -d '{"text":"sample doc"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $DBX_TOKEN" | jq '.embedding' > emb.json
# upsert to qdrant
curl -X POST http://qdrant-qa.svc:6333/collections/test/points -d @emb.json
```

luis: Helpful. Also add a validation step to ensure Snowflake external function latency < 250ms for <512 tokens or we mark it as latency risk.

samir: I'll add a lightweight harness that runs 200 small requests and reports p50/p95. Use `rbx-harness` and set concurrency=8.

anya: Owners + next actions: 1) samir: provision KMS + harness (due Tue EOD). 2) jordan: prepare DBX job + sample dataset (due Tue). 3) qdrant_ops: retention config + healthcheck endpoint (done now). 4) luis: compliance sign-off checklist + enclave requirements (due Wed AM). 5) kate: draft partner comms timeline (due Wed EOD).

deploy-bot: Deployment rbx-integ-2/job-214 kicked at 2026-03-21T17:02:41Z :rocket:

anya: I'll run the smoke Wed 10:00 PT and post results here. If anyone can't make that slot, flag now. :thumbsup: 

kate: Wed 10 PT works for comms team. Will sync draft with partner PM after your smoke pass.

jordan: small question — do we run both vectorization options (openai/onnx) or just onnx for the litmus?

anya: Start with onnx to reduce external API noise, then run openai-backed check if we see quality delta.

samir: noted. I'll add flags in the harness to toggle provider so we can compare p95 + nearest-neighbor recall.

luis: If smoke is green, I'll prepare a short risk matrix for the partner packet (latency, KMS, lead time, quantization).

anya: Perfect. Thanks team — will post the runbook link after I've uploaded it: https://redwood-internal/partnerships/interop-litmus/runbook (draft).

qdrant_ops: :+1: ping if you need increased qps on the qa cluster during the run.

anya: End of thread — will update after smoke.
